about.title: About
about.purpose: EPS Study helps Khmer speakers prepare for the EPS-TOPIK Korean language test with lessons, words, practice questions and timed mock exams.
about.disclaimer: This is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by HRD Korea.
about.privacySummary: There are no accounts. Your progress stays on your device. If you choose to share anonymous exam statistics, only answers and scores are sent, never your name or IP address.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.placeholder: Placeholder text. The owner will replace this policy before launch.
privacy.p1: We do not ask you to create an account and we do not collect personal data.
privacy.p2: Your progress, attempts and mistakes are stored on your device only.
privacy.p3: If you opt in, we receive anonymous exam answers and scores linked to a random one-time code. We do not store IP addresses or user agents.
privacy.p4: We do not use third-party tracking or advertising scripts.
